content: echarts 6.1.0 + vue-echarts 8.0.1 (peer echarts ^6, vue ^3.3, npm 2026-02-18). Most powerful/flexible option (canvas+svg, large datasets, themes, interactions) but heaviest bundle (~1MB+ gzipped core) and Vue wrapper API differs from PrimeVue Chart. Overkill for KPI dashboards needing line/doughnut/bar.
